presets.name: Unchanged
presets.description: Keep the original samples without EQ, extra headroom or channel mixing.

presets.name: Gentle warmth
presets.description: Add a little body and soften the highest frequencies.

presets.name: Warm
presets.description: Add bass body and reduce brightness for recordings that sound thin.

presets.name: Gentle brightness
presets.description: Add definition without strongly boosting the upper midrange.

presets.name: Soft treble
presets.description: Broadly reduce cymbals and sibilance. This does not remove noise or distortion.

presets.name: Gentle bass
presets.description: Moderately boost bass without raising the vocal range.

presets.name: Full bass
presets.description: Add weight below 100 Hz and slightly reduce the range that can sound muddy.

presets.name: Controlled bass
presets.description: Broadly reduce bass when playback sounds heavy.

presets.name: Air
presets.description: Slightly lift the highest frequencies for dull recordings.

presets.name: Presence
presets.description: Bring voices and solo instruments forward with a broad boost at 2 kHz.

presets.name: Dark
presets.description: Reduce brightness and presence for a softer listening balance.

presets.name: Body and detail
presets.description: Add a little bass and air while reducing lower-midrange buildup.

presets.name: Gentle U curve
presets.description: Slightly boost bass and treble while preserving the midrange.

presets.name: Light crossfeed
presets.description: Mix a small amount of low frequencies between channels to reduce extreme separation.

presets.name: Medium crossfeed
presets.description: Use filtered channel mixing for recordings with very wide stereo separation.

presets.name: Strong crossfeed
presets.description: Bring channels closer with filtered mixing, reducing apparent stereo width.

presets.name: Vintage stereo
presets.description: Reduce lateral separation in recordings with voices and instruments at opposite extremes.

presets.name: Intimate listening
presets.description: Use a slightly narrower image and warmer tone. This does not simulate a measured room.

presets.name: Long session
presets.description: Soften the upper midrange and treble for tiring recordings. This is a subjective tone adjustment.

presets.name: Stable center
presets.description: Center voices in wide mixes with a slight reduction in stereo width.

presets.name: Desktop
presets.description: Reduce sub-bass and buildup around 180 Hz as a starting point for desktop speakers.

presets.name: Small speakers
presets.description: Reduce sub-bass energy and some upper bass. This does not extend the speaker's response.

presets.name: Near a wall
presets.description: Broadly reduce bass that can build up near a wall.

presets.name: Less boom · 63 Hz
presets.description: Cut 63 Hz by 4 dB. Use this only for buildup in that range; it is not room calibration.

presets.name: Less boom · 125 Hz
presets.description: Cut 125 Hz by 4 dB. This is a starting point that needs listening checks.

presets.name: Less boxiness
presets.description: Reduce lower-midrange buildup around 300 Hz.

presets.name: Rumble cut
presets.description: Use a second-order high-pass filter at 30 Hz to reduce sub-bass noise.

presets.name: Subsonic cut
presets.description: Use a second-order high-pass filter at 20 Hz, preserving more extension than Rumble cut.

presets.name: Acoustic
presets.description: Add a little presence and air while reducing lower-midrange buildup.

presets.name: Classical
presets.description: Use a subtle curve with slight bass body and a small lift at the highest frequencies.

presets.name: Jazz
presets.description: Add double-bass body and moderate presence for acoustic instruments.

presets.name: Rock
presets.description: Add punch and guitar definition without strongly boosting the highest frequencies.

presets.name: Metal
presets.description: Keep the punch, reduce muddiness and soften cymbals in dense mixes.

presets.name: Electronic
presets.description: Boost sub-bass and add a little air with automatic headroom.

presets.name: Hip hop
presets.description: Add bass weight and a subtle boost to vocal articulation.

presets.name: Pop
presets.description: Use broad bass and treble boosts with a little vocal presence.

presets.name: Ambient
presets.description: Use a warm tone and softer presence while preserving the recording's stereo width.

presets.name: Vocals
presets.description: Reduce the lower midrange and improve vocal clarity. This does not isolate voices.

presets.name: Speech
presets.description: Reduce low-frequency noise and improve speech articulation. This does not separate voices from other sounds.

presets.name: Podcasts
presets.description: Filter low frequencies and use moderate compression to reduce level differences within a conversation.

presets.name: Night
presets.description: Reduce bass and compress peaks without adding makeup gain.

presets.name: Quiet listening
presets.description: Apply fixed bass and air compensation. This does not automatically follow the volume control.

presets.name: Less fatigue
presets.description: Reduce presence and brightness in aggressive recordings.

presets.name: Steady dialogue
presets.description: Improve vocal clarity and use linked-channel compression to control level changes.

presets.name: Background music
presets.description: Use a soft tone and light compression to keep music in the background.

presets.name: Mono
presets.description: Average the left and right channels to hear both sides through one earpiece.

presets.name: Narrow stereo
presets.description: Halve the side information without inverting channels or adding reverberation.

presets.name: Left −3 dB
presets.description: Reduce the left channel by about 3 dB. This is a manual adjustment, not a measured correction.

presets.name: Right −3 dB
presets.description: Reduce the right channel by about 3 dB. This is a manual adjustment, not a measured correction.

presets.name: Left delay · 0.3 ms
presets.description: Delay the left channel by 0.3 ms, about 10 cm of travel at room temperature.

presets.name: Right delay · 0.3 ms
presets.description: Delay the right channel by 0.3 ms. Check which channel arrives first before choosing this.

presets.name: Invert polarity
presets.description: Invert both channels' polarity. This alone cannot correct a reversed connection on one speaker.

flat.name: Sin cambios
flat.description: Conserva los samples originales: sin EQ, margen adicional ni mezcla de canales.

warm-gentle.name: Calidez suave
warm-gentle.description: Un poco más de cuerpo, con el extremo agudo suavizado.

warm.name: Cálido
warm.description: Más cuerpo en graves y menos brillo. Para grabaciones que resultan delgadas.

bright.name: Brillo suave
bright.description: Añade definición sin levantar de forma pronunciada los medios altos.

soft-treble.name: Agudos suaves
soft-treble.description: Reduce platos y sibilancia de forma amplia; no elimina ruido ni distorsión.

bass-gentle.name: Graves suaves
bass-gentle.description: Refuerzo moderado del grave, sin elevar el rango de la voz.

bass-full.name: Graves con cuerpo
bass-full.description: Más peso bajo 100 Hz, con un pequeño recorte donde puede aparecer barro.

bass-controlled.name: Graves contenidos
bass-controlled.description: Recorta graves amplios cuando la reproducción resulta cargada.

air.name: Aire
air.description: Un realce leve en el extremo alto para grabaciones apagadas.

presence.name: Presencia
presence.description: Acerca las voces e instrumentos solistas con un realce ancho en 2 kHz.

dark.name: Oscuro
dark.description: Reduce brillo y presencia para una escucha menos incisiva.

warm-detail.name: Cuerpo y detalle
warm-detail.description: Añade un poco de grave y aire; reduce la acumulación de medios bajos.

gentle-smile.name: Curva suave en U
gentle-smile.description: Graves y agudos ligeramente realzados, con medios conservados.

crossfeed-light.name: Crossfeed ligero
crossfeed-light.description: Mezcla una pequeña parte de los graves entre canales para reducir la separación extrema.

crossfeed-medium.name: Crossfeed medio
crossfeed-medium.description: Mezcla filtrada entre canales para escuchar mezclas estéreo muy separadas.

crossfeed-strong.name: Crossfeed intenso
crossfeed-strong.description: Acerca los canales con mezcla filtrada. Reduce la anchura aparente.

vintage-stereo.name: Estéreo antiguo
vintage-stereo.description: Reduce la separación lateral de grabaciones con voces e instrumentos en extremos opuestos.

intimate.name: Escucha íntima
intimate.description: Imagen un poco más centrada y tono cálido; no simula una sala medida.

long-session.name: Sesión larga
long-session.description: Suaviza medios altos y agudos para grabaciones que cansan; ajuste tonal subjetivo.

headphone-focus.name: Centro estable
headphone-focus.description: Centra las voces de mezclas abiertas con una reducción leve de anchura.

desktop.name: Escritorio
desktop.description: Recorta subgraves y acumulación alrededor de 180 Hz. Punto de partida para un escritorio.

compact-speakers.name: Bocinas pequeñas
compact-speakers.description: Reduce energía subgrave y un poco de grave alto. No promete extender la respuesta de la bocina.

near-wall.name: Cerca de la pared
near-wall.description: Atenúa de forma amplia los graves que pueden acumularse cerca de una pared.

boom-63.name: Menos retumbe · 63 Hz
boom-63.description: Recorte de 4 dB en 63 Hz. Úsalo solo si identificas acumulación en esa zona; no es calibración de sala.

boom-125.name: Menos retumbe · 125 Hz
boom-125.description: Recorte de 4 dB en 125 Hz. Es un punto de partida y requiere comprobar el resultado.

boxiness.name: Menos sonido de caja
boxiness.description: Reduce la acumulación de medios bajos alrededor de 300 Hz.

rumble-cut.name: Recorte de retumbo
rumble-cut.description: Filtro pasaaltos de segundo orden en 30 Hz para reducir ruido subgrave.

subsonic-cut.name: Recorte subsónico
subsonic-cut.description: Filtro pasaaltos de segundo orden en 20 Hz; conserva más extensión que el recorte de retumbo.

acoustic.name: Acústico
acoustic.description: Un poco de presencia y aire, con menos acumulación en medios bajos.

classical.name: Clásica
classical.description: Curva discreta: leve cuerpo en graves y un pequeño realce del extremo alto.

jazz.name: Jazz
jazz.description: Cuerpo para contrabajo y presencia moderada para instrumentos acústicos.

rock.name: Rock
rock.description: Algo más de golpe y definición de guitarra, sin aumentar mucho el extremo agudo.

metal.name: Metal
metal.description: Mantiene el golpe, reduce barro y suaviza platos en mezclas densas.

electronic.name: Electrónica
electronic.description: Refuerzo de subgrave y un poco de aire, con margen automático de nivel.

hip-hop.name: Hip hop
hip-hop.description: Más peso grave y un realce discreto del rango de articulación vocal.

pop.name: Pop
pop.description: Curva amplia de graves y agudos, con una presencia vocal leve.

ambient.name: Ambient
ambient.description: Tono cálido y menos presencia incisiva; mantiene la anchura de la grabación.

vocal.name: Voces
vocal.description: Menos medios bajos y más claridad en el rango de voz, sin aislamiento vocal.

speech.name: Voz hablada
speech.description: Reduce ruido grave y mejora articulación de voz; no separa la voz del resto.

podcast.name: Podcasts
podcast.description: Filtro de graves y compresión moderada para reducir diferencias de nivel dentro de una conversación.

night.name: Noche
night.description: Menos graves y compresión para reducir picos. No añade ganancia de compensación.

quiet-listening.name: Escucha a volumen bajo
quiet-listening.description: Compensación tonal fija de graves y aire. No sigue automáticamente el control de volumen.

fatigue-relief.name: Menos fatiga
fatigue-relief.description: Atenúa la zona de presencia y el brillo en grabaciones agresivas.

dialogue.name: Diálogo estable
dialogue.description: Claridad vocal y compresión enlazada entre canales para controlar cambios de nivel.

background.name: Música de fondo
background.description: Tono suave y compresión ligera para mantener la música en segundo plano.

mono.name: Mono
mono.description: Promedia los canales izquierdo y derecho. Útil para escuchar ambos lados con un solo auricular.

narrow-stereo.name: Estéreo reducido
narrow-stereo.description: Reduce a la mitad la información lateral, sin invertir canales ni añadir reverberación.

left-down-3.name: Izquierdo −3 dB
left-down-3.description: Atenúa el canal izquierdo unos 3 dB. Ajuste manual; no presupone una asimetría medida.

right-down-3.name: Derecho −3 dB
right-down-3.description: Atenúa el canal derecho unos 3 dB. Ajuste manual; no presupone una asimetría medida.

delay-left.name: Retardo izquierdo · 0.3 ms
delay-left.description: Retrasa el canal izquierdo 0.3 ms, aproximadamente 10 cm de recorrido a temperatura ambiente.

delay-right.name: Retardo derecho · 0.3 ms
delay-right.description: Retrasa el canal derecho 0.3 ms. Comprueba qué canal llega primero antes de elegirlo.

invert-polarity.name: Invertir polaridad
invert-polarity.description: Invierte la polaridad de ambos canales. No corrige por sí solo una conexión equivocada de una sola bocina.
